intro.text: An Alethi officer who commands a battalion under Adolin Kholin at the Battle of Narak.

items.text: In heavy rain, Perel's battalion of heavy infantry and spearmen fought under Adolin. When the listeners held their line, Perel called a partial retreat and reported a stalemate, puzzled that some enemies kept singing behind the lines. He warned Adolin against attacking alone, and was sent with soldiers to make a distraction while Adolin went after the singers through the hollow rock.
